newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Northern alliance bombs Kabul again.
newsitem.headline: Northern alliance bombs Kabul again.

text.p: An anti-Taleban warplane bombed Kabul on Wednesday, leaving a big cloud of smoke over a northeastern suburb of the Afghan capital, witnesses said.
It was not immediately clear what the bomber hit in the area, where Kabul airport is located.

The airport has been the target of several raids by bombers sent by northern Uzbek chief Abdul Rashid Dostum, but none have so far damaged it. The airport is used for both civilian and military traffic.

Dostum's bombers have also targeted a military base in northwest Kabul and dropped eight bombs at it on Tuesday. Fighters of the purist Islamic Taleban who took the city nearly six weeks ago, said the bombs caused no damage or casualties.
The only casualties in the air raids so far have been three children, killed when two bombs fell on a northwestern residential area. Seven people were also wounded.
